ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobe areas consist of contiguous high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped along the entire trailing edge, lateral tips, and in dense clusters surrounding the median notch. Multiple dark linear pixel-streaks radiate from the central peduncle insertion towards the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 85 degrees and a high-ratio depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; trailing edge is notably jagged with numerous irregular peaks and valleys, especially on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips, characterized by micro-scale edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized circular dark pixel clusters concentrated along the pigmented margins of the trailing edge and within the central notch region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white surfaces; prominent long-axis streaks are visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive healed rake marks across both ventral lobes and significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
